sections.title: Opening / Problem
sections.visual: Fast UI montage + ProgBiz ERP title / brand reveal
sentences: Managing customer enquiries is easy when everything is in one place.
ProgBiz ERP brings your sales workflow together—from the moment a lead arrives to the moment it is followed up, converted, or closed.
Let’s see how the CRM helps your team stay organized and your managers stay informed.

sections.title: Home
sections.visual: Show Home dashboard and key cards
sentences: Start from the Home screen and get an instant view of the day.
New leads, scheduled follow-ups, delayed activities, and completed work are visible at a glance.
Instead of searching through multiple screens, your team can immediately see what needs attention and move into the right action.
callouts: One place to start your day

sections.title: CRM Dashboard
sentences: For managers, the CRM Dashboard turns sales activity into a clear picture.
Here you can see total leads and how they are distributed across stages such as New, Cold, Warm, Hot, Won, Lost, and other outcomes.
Key metrics such as win rate, conversion rate, lost rate and pipeline value help the team understand what is happening in the sales funnel.
The follow-up summary also separates today’s work, delayed follow-ups and upcoming activities, so important customer actions are easier to prioritize.

sections.title: Leads
sections.visual: Navigate CRM → Leads; demonstrate search/filter/open lead
sentences: Now let’s move to Leads.
This is where sales enquiries can be reviewed and managed from a single workspace.
A lead can contain customer information, enquiry details, lead source, assignment and follow-up information.
Use search and filters to quickly find the right records, open a lead to review its details, and assign the enquiry to the appropriate team member.
This gives every executive a structured view of the customers they need to work on.
callouts: Assign leads to the right executive

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.visual: Open follow-up view; show today/delayed/upcoming; open one record
sentences: The next step is follow-up.
A lead is valuable only when the next action is clear.
With follow-up management, your team can see activities that are due today, delayed, or scheduled for later.
Open a follow-up to review the customer and enquiry context, update the activity, and keep the next action visible.
This helps reduce missed callbacks and keeps the sales process moving.

sections.title: Connected workflow
sections.visual: Animated path between screens: enquiry → assigned executive → follow-up → status → reporting
sentences: The real value comes from the complete workflow.
An enquiry enters the CRM, is assigned to an executive, followed up at the right time, updated through the sales stages, and reflected in the dashboard.
So sales teams work from the same information, while managers get visibility into the overall pipeline.

sections.title: Closing
sentences: ProgBiz ERP CRM gives your team one connected place to manage leads, follow-ups and sales visibility.
Less time searching.
Fewer missed follow-ups.
Better visibility across the pipeline.
ProgBiz ERP—bringing your business workflow together.
sections.end_card_cta: Manage leads. Stay on top of follow-ups. See your pipeline clearly.

visual_rules: Keep the real ProgBiz ERP UI as the hero; do not redesign the product interface; no fake UI elements; no unsupported feature claims.
Smooth cursor movement, deliberate clicks, subtle zoom-ins, focus highlights, short transitions.
On-screen text sparingly: 3–6 words per callout; do not cover important UI with captions.
When a feature is mentioned, visually focus on it within 0.5–1.5 seconds.
Pause 1–2 seconds after each important page loads before clicking.
Demo/test customer names and numbers only; no passwords, tokens, internal URLs or private customer data on screen.
No dead clicks or loading screens in the final cut.
